hints.title: Total must be even
hints.body: An equal split is impossible when the total sum is odd.

hints.title: Find a subset
hints.body: The problem is equivalent to finding a subset whose sum is half the total.

hints.title: Zero-one knapsack
hints.body: Mark reachable sums. Iterate sums downward so each value is used at most once.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
total = sum(nums)
if total is odd: return false
target = total // 2
reachable = array of false, reachable[0] = true
for value in nums:
    for s from target down to value:
        reachable[s] = reachable[s] or reachable[s - value]
return reachable[target]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
